title: Continuous tangential gradient along a C¹ immersion: B(B*B)⁻¹∇F (Simon's ∇^{N_j}f on one chart, Ch. 3, 2.1)
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, let ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P and F : ℝ^d → ℝ be C¹, and let V ⊆ ℝ^d be any set such that Dψ(y) is injective for every y ∈ V. Then there is a map h : ℝ^d → ℝ^P, continuous on V, such that for every y ∈ V: h(y) ∈ Dψ(y)(ℝ^d) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) and ⟨h(y), Dψ(y)e⟩ = DF(y)e for every e ∈ ℝ^d. (h(y) is the gradient at ψ(y) of F∘ψ⁻¹ along the immersed piece.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (F : Euclid d → ℝ) (V : Set (Euclid d)), ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ∃ h : Euclid d → Euclid P, ContinuousOn h V ∧ ∀ y ∈ V, h y ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid d →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ ∀ e : Euclid d, inner ℝ (h y) (fderiv ℝ ψ y e) = fderiv ℝ F y e
